title: Soul of the world
html_source:
A reference to Bruno’s philosophy that the soul of the world was ‘principle and cause of nature (Gifford & Sediman, p33).

Giordano Bruno (of Nola) becomes the Nolan in the wake !

anchor.prefix: ow to partner: so: imps of fancy of the Moors. Gone too from the world, Averroes and Moses Maimonides, dark men in mien and movement, flashing in their mocking mirrors the obscure
anchor.suffix:
, a darkness shining in brightness which brightness could not comprehend.

 — Do you understand now? Can you work the second for yourself? 

 — Yes, sir. 

 In long shaky strokes S
